en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2314 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said on the day of the conquest of Mecca:
"Indeed, Allah (swt), Blessed and Exalted, sanctified Mecca
'on the day He created the heavens and the earth.'
It is sacred until the Day of Resurrection. It was not made lawful for anyone before me, nor will it be made lawful for anyone after me. It was only made lawful for me for one hour of the day."
